elements.title: 3D Scatterplot of Iris Dataset by Species

details.values: Points scattered in 3D space colored by species: purple for setosa, teal for versicolor, yellow for virginica. Petal length increases generally with sepal length and width, with virginica having the largest petal lengths.

elements.summary: This 3D scatterplot visualizes the Iris dataset by plotting sepal length, sepal width, and petal length, with points colored by species to show clustering and differences among setosa, versicolor, and virginica.
